quarterly_data.quarter: Bizlink press release: BizLink Partners with ams OSRAM to Advance Photonics for AI (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: BizLink announced an ecosystem partnership with ams OSRAM to co-develop next-generation optical interconnect solutions for AI scale-up domains, contributing fiber array assembly, optical packaging, optical testing and high-volume manufacturing. The two present a 'wide-and-slow' optical link approach (data spread across many parallel lower-speed channels for low power and low latency) as a demonstrator at ECOC 2026 (Spain, September 21-23), shown in a private room: a connectorized multi-core fiber solution with a 2D addressable microVCSEL array at 850 nm paired with BizLink's fiber-to-fiber connector and optical packaging. This is a demonstration and co-development partnership, not a product in production; ams OSRAM states the goal is to industrialize the architecture at scale. No customers, units, dollar figures or availability dates stated.
